instructions.name: claim_timeout_funds
docs: Contractor claim when timeout flag is set.

instructions.name: claim_timeout_refund
docs: Client refund when timeout flag is set (no dispute).

instructions.name: commit_account
docs: Manual commit any delegated PDA in ER.

instructions.name: commit_and_undelegate_permission
docs: Commit and undelegate a permissioned account back to Solana L1.

instructions.name: commit_escrow
docs: Manual commit of escrow account in ER.

instructions.name: commit_milestones
docs: Commit milestone hash into the escrow (PER-auth).

instructions.name: commit_public_milestones
docs: Commit public milestone hash into the escrow (L1 only).

instructions.name: commit_public_terms
docs: Commit signed public terms into the escrow (L1 only).

instructions.name: commit_terms
docs: Commit signed terms into the escrow (PER-auth).

instructions.name: create_permission
docs: Create a permission for a given account type and member list.

instructions.name: create_private_milestone
docs: Create a private milestone (PER-only). Stores sensitive milestone details off L1.

instructions.name: create_private_terms
docs: Create private terms (PER-only). Intended to run on PER and not be committed to L1.

instructions.name: delegate_account
docs: Delegate any account type to an ER validator for PER execution.

instructions.name: delegate_escrow
docs: Delegate escrow account to an ER validator for PER execution.

instructions.name: init_private_milestone_stub
docs: Initialize a private milestone account on L1 with empty data so it can be delegated to PER.

instructions.name: init_private_terms_stub
docs: Initialize a private terms account on L1 with empty data so it can be delegated to PER.

instructions.name: mutual_cancel_escrow
docs: Mutual cancel: both parties sign to refund remaining funds to client.

instructions.name: set_funding_ok
docs: Set funding_ok flag after verifying funded amount matches private terms.

instructions.name: set_funding_ok_public
docs: Set funding_ok flag after verifying funded amount matches public terms (L1 only).

instructions.name: set_public_terms
docs: Create or update public terms on L1 (no PER). Does not commit to escrow yet.

instructions.name: set_ready_to_claim
docs: Set ready_to_claim when all private milestones are approved.

instructions.name: set_ready_to_claim_public
docs: Set ready_to_claim when all public milestones are approved (L1 only).

instructions.name: set_timeout_funds_ready
docs: Set timeout_funds_ready when deadline has passed and all work was submitted.

instructions.name: set_timeout_funds_ready_public
docs: Set timeout_funds_ready when deadline has passed and all work was submitted (L1 only).

instructions.name: set_timeout_refund_ready
docs: Set timeout_refund_ready when deadline has passed and work is incomplete.

instructions.name: set_timeout_refund_ready_public
docs: Set timeout_refund_ready when deadline has passed and work is incomplete (L1 only).

instructions.name: sign_private_terms
docs: Sign private terms (PER-only). Requires client or contractor via session auth.

instructions.name: sign_public_terms
docs: Sign public terms (L1 only).

instructions.name: undelegate_escrow
docs: Commit and undelegate escrow account back to Solana L1.

instructions.name: undelegate_pda
docs: Commit and undelegate any delegated PDA back to Solana L1.

instructions.name: update_permission
docs: Update an existing permission (e.g., add/remove members).

instructions.name: update_private_milestone_details
docs: Update private milestone details (PER-only).

instructions.name: update_private_milestone_status
docs: Update private milestone status (PER-only).
